association_and_reset.destination_binding: ARM captures local task and expected source_task_seq; source/destination physical peer and format are permanently table-bound
association_and_reset.mismatched_or_late: never mutate current task/valid bits or memory; quarantine/poison and recover
association_and_reset.duplicate: same handled ACK may be consumed/discarded diagnostically; same terminal atmother deduplicated; repeated ARM/RUN/CLOSE/OFFER or malformed/phasewrong data causes protocolfault/poison,never secondwrite/RUN/release; no reliable retransmission claim
association_and_reset.sequence_exhaustion: stop admission, drain all tasks/data/ACK/event/native responses, then advance epoch/reset seq only at quiescence
association_and_reset.epoch_exhaustion: maintenance stop; no automatic modulo reuse without proved cold-reset/isolation of every old source
association_and_reset.leaf_cohort_reset: retain accepted task key/first error/partial in supervisor; reset all participating leaves/helper/endpoints; old-key failure terminal delivered before new epoch admission
association_and_reset.hard_reset: cancels old task/terminal obligations only when all participants/channels reset and no old external response may reappear
association_and_reset.no_reset_cancel: only armed/unstarted, no accepted OFFER/data/native issue; otherwise reject or enter poison/cohort-reset policy
association_and_reset.RAM: not implicitly cleared; invalidate markers/slots and refill actual data

resource_rules: ARM admission proves all required tensor/parameter/gamma/state/output lifetimes, not only one fragment holding slot
consumer ARM/reserve before producer RUN; receive/SACK/ACK can progress before consumer compute
source sealed payload immutable through verified storedACK and explicit source CLOSE/release
one ordinaryS owner; take/capture an S response before another access
never offer future ARM to busy island and block current mandatory CLOSE/recovery on same command path
global1fragment reserves TX/RX/S-input/ACK and terminal capacity before data issue
no same-island task waiting on another not-admittable task on that island; W6 must add actual independent storage or legal materialization
no unbounded progress promise under permanent downstream backpressure
mother asserts neither ARM nor RUN until known admission prerequisites hold; never park impossible RUN ahead of mandatory CLOSE or recovery on singleCMD path
parameter validity for futureprofiles means versioned realreachable storage plus progress-capable tile supply,not all expertweights residentinlocalS; B8 hasno parameter/MEM supply service
